# Growth Recon
> Diagnostic-first growth operating system by Dawid Jozwiak

## About
GrowthRecon is a five-stage growth methodology called RECON: Research, Expose, Convert, Optimize, Navigate. It fixes foundations before tactics, measures impact not activity, and builds self-running systems - not retainer dependencies. Created by Dawid Jozwiak, a growth strategist with 20+ years across PPC, SEO, gambling, crypto, and SaaS.

## The RECON Framework
- Research: Map the business through the customer's eyes - ICP, language, pricing, data, adversarial assessment
- Expose: Strip away vanity metrics, find the ONE objective, audit spend vs. output, kill sacred cows
- Convert: Fix the funnel foundation before spending on traffic - tracking, journey mapping, retention, LTV
- Optimize: Build trackable processes, testing discipline, and reapply the framework as a loop
- Navigate: Drive adoption through internal resistance, train teams, hand over a self-running system

## Author
Dawid Jozwiak - Creator of Growth Recon
Dawid Jozwiak created the RECON framework after two decades of watching
companies pour money into marketing tactics built on broken foundations.
Growth Recon is a five-stage growth strategy framework that starts with
a diagnostic marketing audit - not more ads. Each stage measures marketing
effectiveness at the source: Research maps who actually buys, Expose kills
wasted spend, Convert fixes the funnel, Optimize builds the system,
Navigate makes it stick. The result is a growth engine that compounds
instead of costs more every quarter.
